name: Xivilai
location: Expand for Locations listClose Locations list

abilities.name: Quick Strike
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that deals low physical damage.

abilities.name: Heavy Attack
abilities.description: The Xivilai performs an overhead swing that causes a frost explosion, dealing high frost damage. This can be blocked to set the Xivilai off-balance.

abilities.name: Hand of Flame
abilities.description: The Xivilai sends three fire lines towards its target, indicated by moving red circles, dealing moderate flame damage. The fires split off a second time shortly afterward. This can be interrupted to set the Xivilai off-balance.

abilities.name: Lightning Grasp
abilities.description: The Xivilai raises their hand and shoot a bolt of lightning which strikes five times in their order of apparition, as indicated by small red circles, dealing low shock damage each.

abilities.name: Ice Cage
abilities.description: The Xivilai summons a ring of frost around themselves, indicated by a donut-shaped red circle, dealing continuous moderate frost damage and snaring targets. This cannot be blocked.

abilities.name: Summon Daedra
abilities.description: The Xivilai summons a Daedra to fight for them. It can either be a Clannfear, Flame Atronach, Flame Ogrim, Spider Daedra, or a Winged Twilight. The daedra scales with the difficulty and location of the summoner. The daedra spawns with the summoner's current Health, for a maximum of 80% of the summoner's Max Health and have extreme damage resistance during the summoning animation. The summoner's Physical and Spell Resistance are reduced to 0 while a summon is active, as indicated by a blue glow on them. The daedra automatically dies if its summoner is defeated.

abilities.name: Empower Weapon: Frost
abilities.description: The Xivilai infuse their weapon with frost which makes "Quick Strike" apply a snaring effect (Frost Edge).

Eastern Solstice, Deetra Grotto, Near Warm-Stone Village, Worm Cult Camp north of Western Solstice, Xul-Katama Xivilai (listenLink⏵) are powerful horned humanoid Daedra who often serve Molag Bal. They wield two-handed weapons in battle, usually Daedric battle axes. They often come in pairs. They have blue skin and yellow eyes, and somewhat resemble the Dremora, who can be differentiated by their red eyes.
